findings.heading: Findings and next steps
findings.description: Fix the records listed, then reload this page to check again.
findings.passingSummary: {count, plural, one {# check passes} other {# checks pass}}

inventory-located.title: All inventory has a physical location
inventory-located.description: Every active unit must be traceable to the room it is stored in. A unit without a location cannot be reconciled during an inspection.
inventory-located.nextStep: Open each unit and record where it is, using a location move.

cultivar-attribution.title: All units are attributed to a cultivar
cultivar-attribution.description: The cultivar is part of the required description of the cannabis held under a licence.
cultivar-attribution.nextStep: Open each unit and choose its cultivar.

provenance-recorded.title: All units declare a lawful source
provenance-recorded.regulation: Cannabis Regulations s.222: source of cannabis
provenance-recorded.description: Each unit must record how it entered the site: produced on site, received from a licence holder, or imported under permit.
provenance-recorded.nextStep: Open each unit and record its source.

destruction-documented.title: Every destruction records a reason
destruction-documented.description: A destruction record must state the reason. A blank record is an inspection finding.
destruction-documented.nextStep: Contact your quality lead. A destruction record cannot be edited, so the gap must be explained in a documented note on the unit.

destruction-filed-promptly.title: Destructions are filed promptly
destruction-filed-promptly.description: Destruction records should be filed within {days} days of the destruction, not batched or back-filled long afterwards.
destruction-filed-promptly.nextStep: File destructions the same day. For the records listed, document why they were filed late.

transfers-scanned.title: Location moves are confirmed by barcode scan
transfers-scanned.regulation: Cannabis Regulations s.244: chain of custody
transfers-scanned.description: A move confirmed by scanning the unit label gives a defensible chain of custody. An unconfirmed move relies on memory.
transfers-scanned.nextStep: From now on, scan the unit label when moving it. The records listed cannot be changed.

shipment-licence.title: Shipments record the other party’s licence number
shipment-licence.description: Records of cannabis sent or received must identify the other licence holder, including the licence number.
shipment-licence.nextStep: Add the licence number to the organization, then to each shipment listed.

shipments-reconciled.title: No shipment is left unreconciled
shipments-reconciled.description: A shipment still in transit after {days} days has not been reconciled against a delivery confirmation.
shipments-reconciled.nextStep: Contact the receiving party, then record the delivery or cancel the shipment.

harvest-weights.title: Harvested material has a recorded weight
harvest-weights.description: Harvested cannabis must be quantified in grams, wet or dry, to appear on a CTLS monthly return.
harvest-weights.nextStep: Weigh each unit listed and record the weight as a measurement.

experiment-attribution.title: Units belong to a research experiment
experiment-attribution.description: Material held under a research licence should be attributable to the study it supports.
experiment-attribution.nextStep: Assign each unit to its experiment when you next edit it.

quality-holds.title: Quality holds are documented and resolved
quality-holds.regulation: Good production practices: holds and nonconforming product
quality-holds.description: A unit on hold needs a reason and an investigation. An unresolved hold freezes transfers, derivations and destruction.
quality-holds.nextStep: Review each held unit in Holds & incidents and release it or keep the hold with a documented reason.

open-incidents.title: Quality incidents are closed out
open-incidents.regulation: Good production practices: complaints, deviations and corrective action
open-incidents.description: Open nonconformances must be investigated and closed with a recorded resolution.
open-incidents.nextStep: Open each incident, finish the investigation and close it with a resolution.
